title: Resolve isolated repository identity
userIntent: List the repository registered for this isolated evaluation trial and identify its public repository type.

intendedBehavior: Exactly the trial repository is discoverable as a local Git repository before extra fixtures are registered.
behavioralInvariants: Discovery stays bound to the isolated Controller Home.
regressionRisks: Host repositories leak into a trial or the primary repository is not registered.

provenance.note: Shared behavior anchored to the exact Forge v1.7.2 release commit.
